title: Intuitive Machines Secures Sixth NASA CLPS Award to Establish High-Volume Lunar Utility Pipeline
excerpt: The firm-fixed-price CLPS award is valued up to USD 148.3 million, including a USD 79.7 million performance incentive tied to successful product-line qualification.
summary: The current issuer page continues to support the bounded June 30 CLPS catalyst and its qualification-dependent economics.
